headline: Colombia Proposes Expanding Strategic Minerals List to 28
summary: The Colombian National Mining Agency (ANM) has proposed increasing the number of minerals classified as strategic from 17 to 28. The project is currently open for public comment.
why: Strategic minerals are essential for national development and industrial policy. Changes in classification can influence future mining investment and resource extraction regulations in Colombia.

impacts.name: Mining Sector
impacts.why: New regulations on strategic minerals directly affect mining operations and exploration.
